11.by: Claude, play.html benchmark() in the Claude desktop browser pane on an Apple M3 laptop (integrated GPU), pane hidden; not a human-observed frame counter
11.note: N8.4 re-measure on the heaviest map there now is: district 100 (372 x 232 m city, COBALT, Architects), Medium, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, GPU forced to finish every frame, camera turning a full circle. Three runs: mean 5.3 / 7.3 / 8.4 ms (119-189 fps), p95 10.7-12.2 ms, worst 16.1 ms, 132 draw calls, 272k triangles at most (218 render chunks). Before N8.4 (build 23) the same case was mean 12.4 ms, p95 17.0 ms, 609k triangles. High (shadows, following box): mean 5.3 ms, p95 7.8 ms, 157 calls. Timings in a hidden pane vary by about a third between runs. Weaker laptops and phones: not measured. Build 14's measurement (districts 10 and 91 on 32 x 20 maps, mean 4.2-13.3 ms) is in decisions.md R44.
